C0687.title: Bai Jing and Accomplices Manipulated Bonds via Type-C Accounts to Embezzle 206 Million Yuan in State Funds
C0687.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate's thirty-second batch of guiding cases reported that, between 2008 and 2010, Bai Jing, former head of the RMB Investment Division at the investment center of the financial markets department of a state-owned Bank A, conspired with Fan and others to exploit their duties in bond trading at Bank A and Securities Company B. They introduced companies A and B, which Bai controlled, into the transaction chain, opened Type-C accounts, manipulated 73 bond trades, and siphoned more than RMB 206 million in state-owned funds. Bai fled abroad in 2013 and was later subject to an Interpol red notice. In November 2020, the Hohhot Intermediate People's Court ruled that nine properties bought with his embezzlement proceeds be confiscated.
